title: fix: refresh harness setup and update guidance
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Launch DSH with explicit @latest and select Python 3.12 for Bloom installation.
- Document native update commands and current OpenClaw/Pi Node requirements.
- Bump Polli CLI to 0.1.15 to ship the refreshed guidance, including #14838.
- Verify current releases locally: DSH 0.1.5-rc.1, OpenCode 1.18.30 + plugin 6.5.5, OpenClaw 2026.9.4, Pi 0.85.1, Prime 0.9.4 and Bloom 0.1.3.
- All 111 CLI tests, build and changed-code lint pass. Latest harnesses load generated configurations/catalogs; DSH reaches the expected 401 with a dummy key. Successful paid inference is not claimed.

Follow-up to #14666. No provider schema or alias-resolution changes.

gist.headline: Harnesses, freshly watered
gist.blurb: Polli CLI 0.1.15 refreshes the setup map for the current crop of coding harnesses. DSH now starts from @latest with Python 3.12 for Bloom, while the guide records the native update paths and current OpenClaw/Pi requirements.
gist.summary: Bumped Polli CLI to 0.1.15, updated DSH setup to launch via @latest with Python 3.12 for Bloom, and refreshed CODING_HARNESSES.md with native update commands and verified versions for DSH, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, Prime, and Bloom.
gist.impact: Developers setting up current harness releases get working generated configurations and catalog loading guidance, with DSH reaching the expected authentication check using a dummy key.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed workstation represents refreshed local coding-harness setup: Polli, wearing a tiny mechanic tool belt, tends labeled code-plants for DSH, Bloom, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, and Prime. A friendly CRT monitor robot displays a clean harness catalog while a retro terminal shows a small successful setup check, surrounded by flowers and lime-green configuration sprouts.
